title: Coherence of ordinary pullback on refined three-step paths
statement: For schemes X,A,B,C,K,L,W, maps f:A→X, sK:B→A, sL:C→A, pK:K→B, pL:L→C, rK:K→W, rL:L→W, h:W→X, d:C→B,z:L→K satisfying d≫sK=sL, z≫pK=pL≫d, z≫rK=rL, (pK≫sK)≫f=rK≫h and (pL≫sL)≫f=rL≫h, define rhoK and rhoL by ordinary pullback composition and congruence along the total paths. Define gamma by d≫sK=sL, beta by z≫rK=rL, and delta by z≫pK=pL≫d. Each supplied isomorphism is equated to its explicit ordinary construction. Then z*(rhoK_M)≫delta_(f* sK* M)≫pL*(gamma_M inverse)=beta_(h* M)≫rhoL_M for all X-modules M. No tensor pullback, open cover, or chosen adjunction occurs. Schemes are as in [def-pc-scheme], and every pullback is the ordinary module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback].

proof.text: Prove the private componentwise reassociation identity refinement_comp_assoc directly from Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pseudofunctor_associativity. Substitute the named composite maps, evaluate the natural-transformation equality at M, precompose with the direct composition comparison, and cancel inverse comparisons. pullbackCongr is eqToIso, so substitution and proof irrelevance discharge all equality transports.

Derive refinement_comp_square from two applications of refinement_comp_assoc and cancellation of the final pullbackComp. In the main theorem substitute the five supplied isomorphisms using their equalities to their constructions. Expand their components, whiskerings and associators. Derive HT: z then pK then sK equals pL then sL from Hz and Hd, and use refinement_comp_square at f-star M to replace the delta/gamma portion by the comparison for HT followed by inverse pullbackComp pL sL.

Derive HU: z then rK then h equals rL then h from H0. Apply refinement_comp_assoc to z, pK then sK, f using HT, HK, HL and HU, and to z, rK, h using H0 and HU. Postcompose both sides of the desired equality with pullbackComp pL sL and then with pullbackComp (pL then sL) f followed by pullbackCongr HL. Cancel the inverse comparisons, rewrite by the first associativity identity, cancel mapped inverse comparisons, and finish with the second identity. This proves the original component equality for every M without additional assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinary_pullback_refinement_coherence
    {X A B C K L W : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : A ⟶ X) (sK : B ⟶ A) (sL : C ⟶ A)
    (pK : K ⟶ B) (pL : L ⟶ C) (rK : K ⟶ W) (rL : L ⟶ W) (h : W ⟶ X)
    (d : C ⟶ B) (z : L ⟶ K)
    (Hd : d ≫ sK = sL) (Hz : z ≫ pK = pL ≫ d) (H0 : z ≫ rK = rL)
    (HK : (pK ≫ sK) ≫ f = rK ≫ h) (HL : (pL ≫ sL) ≫ f = rL ≫ h)
    (M : X.Modules) :
    let S := pullback f
    let QK := pullback sK
    let QL := pullback sL
    let PK := pullback pK
    let PL := pullback pL
    let RK := pullback rK
    let RL := pullback rL
    let D := pullback d
    let Zf := pullback z
    let rhoK0 : pullback h ⋙ RK ≅ (S ⋙ QK) ⋙ PK :=
      pullbackComp rK h ≪≫ (pullbackCongr HK).symm ≪≫
      (pullbackComp (pK ≫ sK) f).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft S (pullbackComp pK sK).symm ≪≫
      (Functor.associator S QK PK).symm
    let rhoL0 : pullback h ⋙ RL ≅ (S ⋙ QL) ⋙ PL :=
      pullbackComp rL h ≪≫ (pullbackCongr HL).symm ≪≫
      (pullbackComp (pL ≫ sL) f).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft S (pullbackComp pL sL).symm ≪≫
      (Functor.associator S QL PL).symm
    let gamma0 : S ⋙ QL ≅ (S ⋙ QK) ⋙ D := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft S
      ((pullbackCongr Hd).symm ≪≫ (pullbackComp d sK).symm) ≪≫
      (Functor.associator S QK D).symm
    let beta0 : RK ⋙ Zf ≅ RL := pullbackComp z rK ≪≫ pullbackCongr H0
    let delta0 : PK ⋙ Zf ≅ D ⋙ PL :=
      pullbackComp z pK ≪≫ pullbackCongr Hz ≪≫ (pullbackComp pL d).symm
    ∀ (rhoK : pullback h ⋙ RK ≅ (S ⋙ QK) ⋙ PK) (_ : rhoK = rhoK0)
      (rhoL : pullback h ⋙ RL ≅ (S ⋙ QL) ⋙ PL) (_ : rhoL = rhoL0)
      (gamma : S ⋙ QL ≅ (S ⋙ QK) ⋙ D) (_ : gamma = gamma0)
      (beta : RK ⋙ Zf ≅ RL) (_ : beta = beta0)
      (delta : PK ⋙ Zf ≅ D ⋙ PL) (_ : delta = delta0),
    Zf.map (rhoK.hom.app M) ≫ delta.hom.app ((S ⋙ QK).obj M) ≫
      PL.map (gamma.inv.app M) = beta.hom.app ((pullback h).obj M) ≫
        rhoL.hom.app M
